title: Injectivity of the polynomial-localization residue differential comparison
statement: Let k be a field and A a local commutative k-algebra, with residue field K. Let F be an intermediate field k⊆F⊆K [def-pc-field-extension]. Let φ:R=k[y_1,...,y_m]→A be a k-algebra map [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], and let a_i∈F have image res_A(φ(y_i)). Suppose da_i is an F-basis of Ω[F/k] [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. Set p=φ⁻¹(m_A), B=R_p [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], and K₀=κ(B) [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Then the canonical map K₀⊗_B Ω[B/k]→Ω[K₀/k] is injective. No geometric regularity, characteristic hypothesis or finite-generation hypothesis on F is assumed.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07E6, proof (lines 8866-8894), from the construction of A_0 to injectivity of the right vertical cotangent comparison; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07E6

proof.text: Define f:R→F by y_i↦a_i. The equation on residues shows that its composite to K is res_A∘φ. Elements outside p therefore have nonzero, hence invertible, f-images. Localization gives g:B→F. If x∈m_B, express x=r/s, so r∈p; then f(r)=0 and g(x)=0. Conversely g(x) invertible forces x invertible. Thus g is local and descends to the field embedding ρ:K₀→F, preserving the k-structure.

proof.text: Localize the polynomial differential basis dX_i and extend its scalars to K₀. Mathlib mvPolynomialBasis, KaehlerDifferential.isLocalizedModule_map, Basis.ofIsLocalizedModule and Basis.baseChange give the basis e_i=1⊗dX_i of K₀⊗_B Ω[B/k].

proof.text: Lift Ω[B/k]→Ω[F/k] across scalar extension to a K₀-linear map t. On e_i it gives da_i=b_i. The family b is independent over F and remains independent over K₀ by restriction along the injective field map ρ. Therefore t is injective by its values on a basis.

proof.text: On every e_i, the composite of the residue differential comparison and Ω[K₀/k]→Ω[F/k] equals t, since ρ(res_B(x))=g(x). Basis extensionality proves equality of these linear maps. Injectivity of t implies injectivity of the residue comparison.

theorem injective_residue_differential_comparison_of_basis
    (k : Type u) (A : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    [IsLocalRing A]
    (F : IntermediateField k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A))
    (m : ℕ) (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k →ₐ[k] A)
    (a : Fin m → F)
    (ha : ∀ i : Fin m, (a i : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) =
      IsLocalRing.residue A (φ (MvPolynomial.X i)))
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin m) F (KaehlerDifferential k F))
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin m, b i = KaehlerDifferential.D k F (a i)) :
    let p := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).comap φ.toRingHom
    Function.Injective (KaehlerDifferential.mapBaseChange k
      (Localization.AtPrime p) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p)))
